coach_says: TSB is -55.5 and Garmin flags UNPRODUCTIVE with a declining fitness trend, so this week prioritises recovery over everything else, dropping to a single quality block (Tuesday's committed double hard day) with all other sessions easy or full rest. Strength work is trimmed to one lighter session to preserve movement quality without adding fatigue, and the aerobic-high (tempo/threshold) shortage will be addressed once TSB recovers into a sustainable range. Consistency and recovery this week protect long-term progression rather than chasing this week's load targets.

days.details:
Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4x150m (first 50m easy / next 100m moderate), 20 sec rest
Cooldown: 100m easy
Total: ~1000m
Objective: light aerobic stimulus, no fatigue accumulation ahead of Tuesday's double hard day.

days.session: AM Hills Road Ride + PM Hard MTB Group Ride (committed double hard day)
days.details:
AM (45-50 min) | Objective: Hill strength/threshold
10 min Zone 2 warm-up
5-6 x 3 min Zone 4 hill efforts (3 min Zone 1-2 recovery)
10 min cool-down

PM (60 min) | Objective: MTB group ride - technical/anaerobic
Hard group pace, varied terrain, surges Zone 4-5
Ride within group dynamics, manage effort where possible
This is a non-negotiable committed double hard day - no additional hard work scheduled around it.

Complete rest - mandatory recovery from Tuesday's double hard day per constraint. Optional light stretching or short walk only if desired, no structured training. Focus on sleep, hydration, and nutrition to support recovery given TSB of -55.5.

Workout A (light load - deload style):
Warm-up: 5-10 min easy bike + dynamic mobility

Romanian Deadlift 3x6 (light-moderate load, 2-3 reps in reserve)
Reverse Lunge 3x8 each leg
Chest Supported Row 3x10
Dumbbell Bench Press 3x10
Pallof Press 3x10 each side
Dead Bug 2x10 each side

Main lifts: 2 min rest
Accessories: 60 sec rest
Objective: maintain strength stimulus and movement quality without adding systemic fatigue.

75 min | Objective: Aerobic endurance, low fatigue cost
75 min continuous Zone 1-2, flat/rolling terrain preferred
No intervals, conversational pace throughout
Keep effort restrained given current fatigue status.

150 min | Objective: Aerobic base, weekly long ride
20 min Zone 2 warm-up
100 min steady Zone 1-2 (fuel and hydrate consistently, watch for wind ~18.5 km/h)
30 min Zone 1-2 cool-down
No structured intensity - purely aerobic volume, stop early if fatigue signals appear.

45 min gentle flow yoga focused on hip mobility, thoracic rotation, and breathing. Emphasis on relaxation and parasympathetic recovery after Saturday's long ride, closing the week in a low-stress state ahead of next week's reassessment.
